title: Alles kulturhus fire concept for change of use (Brannkonsept Ombygging/bruksendring), rev. C03
jurisdiction: Norway, Ringerike kommune planning-hearing folder (client Stiftelsen Ringerike Kultureiendom). Comparative only, not Alberta.
code_edition: TEK17 § 11 cited (p. 4); NS 3960, NS 1838 / NS-EN 3926 and NS-EN 12845 cited for systems (p. 4)

facts.text: Title block: Alles kulturhus, Brannkonsept, Ombygging/bruksendring; Oppdragsnr 52101259; Dokumentnr F_NO_001; Versjon C03; Dato 2022-12-21.
Client Stiftelsen Ringerike Kultureiendom; consultant Norconsult AS.
Building has 7 storeys above ground and is placed in fire class 3. The concept is said to meet the requirements of TEK17 § 11.
Revision C03 records an implemented deviation (fravik) on omitting fire insulation of ventilation ducts and omitting a bypass on an air-handling unit.
Named people for deviation documentation: door widths (fraviksdokumentasjon dørbredder) and the air-handling-unit bypass.
Contents include '1.3 Prosjekteringsmodell og oversikt over fravik og særskilte vurderinger' (design model and overview of deviations and special assessments), starting p. 13.

Document register lists fire drawings as separate documents (Branntegning plan U1, plan 01, plan 02; rev. C02, dated 2022-02-14). A keyword scan found the drawing titles only in the register and in running text, and no plan sheet was identified.
facts.locator: PDF p. 13; keyword scan of pp. 13, 18, 28

facts.text: Named roles: fire-design lead (RIBr) Norconsult AS; independent control of the fire concept by Roar Jørgensen AS.

limitations: Comparative test only (Norway, Ringerike kommune). The 'implemented' deviation is applicant wording, not authority acceptance.
Drawing check used text labels only; the drawings were not reviewed visually.
